tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Find products by name, vendor or id, optionally filtered by category, API access level or whether the vendor has an MCP server or AI connector. Returns one row per product; call get_product for the quoted evidence behind each value.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Everything on record about connecting to one product: access level, auth methods, sandbox, docs, OpenAPI, webhooks, SDKs, rate limits, partner program, how to get access, what the docs don't say, and linked MCP servers. Each fact has its state, checked date and a verbatim quote in sources[].

tools.name: compare_access
tools.description: Side by side: access level, auth, sandbox, docs, OpenAPI, webhooks, SDKs, rate limits, how to get access and partner program for 2 to 10 products, with the state and checked date of each value.

tools.name: list_mcp_servers
tools.description: MCP servers and AI connectors published by wealth technology vendors: endpoint, status (live or announced), kind, tool count and the products they connect to.

tools.name: get_mcp_server
tools.description: Full record for one vendor MCP server or AI connector: endpoint, transport, auth, scope, how it is enabled, price, listings and its tools (read or write), with quoted evidence in sources[].

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Dated changelog entries: new products, changed access facts, new MCP servers. Use since to get only recent entries.

tools.name: get_form_adv_column
tools.description: What one column of the SEC's monthly investment adviser (Form ADV) CSV means: the Form ADV Part 1A item, the question as worded on the form, its type, observed values and gotchas. Matches the exact column name (e.g. "5E(1)" or "Organization CRD#") or a normalized name (crd_number); otherwise returns

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The product categories wealthtech.dev covers, with how many products each holds.
